//: This project has no build step — Node 22 runs the TypeScript directly by
stripping types, which means nothing ever type-checks these files at
runtime. This config exists purely so the editor understands that setup
noEmit is therefore the point: tsc is a linter here, never a compiler.
'types': [] keeps us from requiring @types/node as a dependency — the
handful of Node globals we actually touch are declared in types/node-globals.d.ts.
